name: deepx_generate_character
description: Generate a character directly inside Google Flow's native Character Studio using Imagen 3 / 🍌 Nano Banana 2.1 and automatically assign their name according to the story and script. Navigates to the Character Studio, submits character appearance prompt, generates candidate cards, sets the official character name (e.g. 'rohan_student'), and saves the character for @mention referencing in video/image scenes.

character_name.description: Character name/handle according to the story/script (e.g. 'rohan_student', 'rohan_ca', 'saraswati_mother').

model.description: Image model for character generation (default: '🍌 Nano Banana 2.1').

prompt.description: Detailed visual description of character (features, expression, clothes, age, 2.5D or cinematic style).
